- Updated application icon
- Added a new song! Hypermind
- Adjusted the UI layout in the Main Menu and others

This is the official pre-release build before going fully public

notes.title: PTB v1.6.1 Update!
notes.notes:
- Updated application icon
- Fixed leaderboard toggle buttons
- Locked mouse cursor to game window in gameplay

notes.title: PTB v1.6.0 Update!
notes.notes:
- New Modifier: Hardcore (Disables cursor, cube outlines and trail. You'll have to aim with the ships position only)
- Complete UI overhaul! Everything now looks more consistent, simpler, more professional
- Added volume mixer: You can now adjust Menu BG, Preview, SFX and master volume
- Added a trail to the Gameplay to improve sight readability
- Yet another redesign of the Song Selection
- New Main Menu
- New Results animation
- Added sounds to UI
- Added resolution setting
- Added credits
- Various bug fixes
- Performance improvements thanks to a render pipeline redo
- Scores with sudden death won't have an icon anymore. It's now used to indicate hardcore
- Improved Post FX
- Menus are now always locked with VSync

notes.title: PTB v1.5.0 Update!
notes.notes:
- [b]Completely new Song selection[/b] (Let us know, what you think)
- [b]Added 2 new Songs! Destroy and Vessel[/b]
- [b]Added practice mode![/b] Select a start time and song speed. Practice a part until you master it
- [b]Manual mode does no longer submit scores![/b] This change has happened as manual mode gives an unfair advantage to some users
- [b]Added several accessibility options![/b] (You can now disable, flash events, color change events and the shake effect. You can find them under the visuals tab in the song selection)
- Song selection no longer lags when scrolling over custom songs
- Removed ship from Results and Failed UI
- Added curated difficulty rating for sorting by difficulty
- Updated several prefabs
- Added FPS limiter
- Added toggle to switch between 2 cube rotation mode. Button is called uniform rotation
- Fixed several issues with the leaderboard
- Fixed volume while adjusting volume
- Updated fading between songs to be smoother while scrolling through many songs
- Lowered laser bloom intensity
- Change interpolation mode for skins from Bilinear to Nearest neighbor (makes the skins less blurry)


- You can now select multiple consecutive object by shift + right click (just like in Windows explorer)
- Map Editor is more snappy when changing stuff
- Selected cubes will now have a blue trail
